facts.text: ManiSkill environments are built on the OpenAI Gym interface
The basic example constructs an environment with gym.make('OpenCabinetDoor-v0')
OpenCabinetDoor-v0 is registered through gym.register with entry point mani_skill.env.open_cabinet_door_drawer:OpenCabinetDoorEnv
The action space is Box(low=-1, high=1, shape=agent.action_range().shape)
The mobile_a2_single_arm robot config has 13 controllable joints
Each step clips the action to [-1, 1] and scales it to the agent's action range
step advances frame_skip control steps of the agent and the scene and returns obs, reward, done, info
One environment step covers frame_skip / control_frequency seconds
The BaseEnv constructor's default frame_skip is 5 and its default max_episode_steps is 200
The mobile_a2_single_arm robot config sets control_frequency to 100
In state mode get_obs returns get_state(with_controller_state=False)
get_state concatenates the actor states, the padded articulation states, the task info and the agent state
get_pad_articulation_state returns the 13 pose/velocity values then 2 * max_dof internal values
OpenCabinetEnvBase.configure_env sets cabinet_max_dof to 8
The target indicator is an 8-element zero vector with a 1 at the target joint's active index
The state-mode observation space is a Box whose bounds are -inf and inf
target_qpos = lmin + (lmax - lmin) * custom['open_extent']
The open_cabinet_door config sets custom.open_extent to 0.9
The success flag open_enough is true when the target joint's qpos is at least target_qpos
seed sets the main seed and a numpy RandomState from it
reset(level) seeds the level RNG from level and, when level is None, draws a 32-bit level from the main RNG

determinism.notes: reset(seed) (or cap.world.seed.v1 before a reset) fixes the fake's initial opening and the analytic transition is deterministic, so one seed repeats a trajectory; upstream reset(level) seeds numpy's RandomState from the level, and the fake uses Python's random.Random, so a seed does not select the same episode in the two

gaps: analytic kinematic model: no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, joints or actuators; the drawer opens by a fixed fraction per step, so no force, contact or actuator fidelity is claimed (F0)

the 75-value observation has the shape of the state-mode vector (cabinet pose/state, 8-element target indicator, 38-value agent state), but only the cabinet root quaternion, the target joint qpos and the target indicator carry modelled values; the agent state and velocities are placeholder zeros
the dense reward is an analytic distance to the target opening, not the upstream compute_dense_reward
state observations only: no rendering, point cloud or RGB-D observation, and no cameras
the episode ends on success or after a fixed 200-step cap held in the fake; the upstream cap is the max_episode_steps constructor argument
the fake and upstream do not share a random stream: a seed gives different episodes in the two
the sim backend (gym.make('OpenCabinetDoor-v0')) was not run; it needs SAPIEN, a GPU and the PartNet Mobility assets

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
